title: First transaction of each account
statementMd:
For accounts 1 to 5 show the earliest transaction (date, id, amount); tie on date goes to the lowest id.

Expected columns: `account_id`, `tx_date`, `id`, `amount`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH r AS (SELECT account_id, tx_date, id, amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY tx_date, id) AS rn FROM transactions WHERE account_id <= 5) SELECT account_id, tx_date, id, amount FROM r WHERE rn = 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
